messages:
Anya M.: Heads-up: SableTech wants a cooperative benchmark next sprint. Scope: watts/throughput (perf/W) and sustained tokens/sec at seq=1024 on 70W and 300W caps. Also compare kernel branches and a small model-scaling sweep (6B, 13B). Who can drive test harness + reproducibility?

Rafael G.: I'll own the harness. Plan to use our runkit runner + telemetry exporter. We'll collect wall-power (PDU), GPU telemetry, p50/p95 latencies, and per-step token throughput.

Noah T.: Kernel matrix: mainline, opt-thread-3, opt-matmul-ct. Quant: bf16, fp16, q4_1. Need to capture L2/L3 cache misses and memory BW. Also add a steady-state warmup of 300 iterations.

Priya (SableTech): SableTech can provide two boards and inline INA power meters. We need the exact commands and env to replicate. Also please include a short reproducibility README for our on-site engineers.

Anya M.: Good. Legal: confirm NDA covers telemetry and co-branded release with embargo.

legal-bot: NDA check: clause 3.2 covers telemetry share to partner and vendor. Public release requires mutual written signoff. Recommend 10-business-day embargo by default.

Rafael G.: Runner prototype command:
```
runkit bench --model redwood-open-13b --seq 1024 --batch 1 --iters 600 \
  --telemetry pdu,gpu,prom --quant bf16 --out s3://partners/sabletech/bench-3105551234
```

Noah T.: Env flags to toggle kernels and caps:
```
export RKERNEL_BRANCH=opt-matmul-ct
export SABLE_PWR_LIMIT=70
export WARMUP=300
```

ops-bot: infra ticket created: INFRA-2278. Provisioned: isolated-vlan-sabletech, vpn creds pending, reserved-dedicated-pool: dev-gpu-small.

Priya (SableTech): Confirming embargo of 10 business days is fine. We'll sign the release form once we see final CSVs. Also request we do a short 30-min sync during run-week to review thermal anomalies live.

Rafael G.: Proposed schedule: May 10 dry-run, May 12-13 formal sweep across kernels and quant modes; each config = 4 repeats. Will push runbook + scripts to s3 by EOD May 6.

Anya M.: Marketing note: do not draft marketplace listing until partner signoff. Assigning @Rafael to keep marketing looped. Also we'll prepare a co-authored blurb but hold publication.

Priya (SableTech): SableTech will provide thermal logs and our internal reference numbers. We'll validate within a 15% delta for perf/W.

Noah T.: I'll assemble perf-summary schema: fields => config, kernel, quant, power_cap, tokens_per_sec_p50,p95,avg_watts,efficiency_tokens_per_watt. Will include raw traces in artifacts.

Anya M.: Great. Rafael/Noah pair to finalize run commands and runbook; Priya to confirm arrival times for boards; legal-bot to track signoff; ops-bot to assign VPN creds. Sync call Thursday to finalize. :white_check_mark:
